items.name: Not enough water lets stones form
Fever plus vomiting is an emergency

closing.headline: Wave-like side pain with blood in the urine is worth suspecting as a kidney stone.
closing.tip: Drink enough water to keep urine pale yellow throughout the day.
closing.cta: Fever or vomiting means the ER; otherwise a urologist can confirm the stone's size.
